enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Remain asleep. Wake up at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up to start the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Pour eggs into pan. Scramble eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Remove toast from toaster. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on toast. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Clear dishes. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and gathering work essentials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Turn off light. Pick up phone from desk. Unplug phone charger. Pick up keys from dresser. Pick up work badge. Pick up stethoscope. Put items in bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirrors. Drive. Stop at traffic lights. Continue driving. Park car in hospital parking lot. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Review patient notes. Walk to patient room 1. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Walk to patient room 2. Knock. Enter. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Attend team meeting. Eat lunch. Return to work. Complete paperwork. End shift.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic lights. Continue driving. Park car in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Lock car. Walk to front door. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Pour water into glass. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear dishes. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Pick up dishes from sink. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor. Pick up broom. Sweep kitchen floor. Put broom away. Wipe table. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Turn off light. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing night hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply moisturizer. Put on pajamas. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with reading and light screen time before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through apps. Read messages. Type reply. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain asleep.
